description: Portrait of O'Keeffe standing in the desert landscape looking down holding a large bull or cow head along with its backbone and ribs; she wears a black wide brimmed hat with a bandana or scarf, a dark  buttoned denim  shirt with a black long sleeve sweater, jeans and leather work gloves; she stands holding the backbone with her right hand while grasping the horns of the head in her left hand at her side
title: In the Navajo Country
